headline: Product & Digital Marketing | Customer Research | Cross-Functional Delivery
headline_rationale: MaintainX needs product-to-market translation, messaging, research and analytics across product and sales. Use verified product/operations coordination, audience research, content and technical delivery without inventing SaaS launches or adoption ownership.
summary: Digital marketer who connects technical work, customer research and commercial execution. Directed marketing and e-commerce activity with sales, product, operations, finance and IT partners, using cost-benefit analysis to prioritize product and growth investments. Developed content across web and email, advised agency clients on campaign goals and messaging, and built reporting with Tableau, Databricks and SQL. Hands-on website and integration experience supports clear collaboration with technical teams and practical, evidence-based marketing recommendations.
factual_review: Read exact MaintainX Product Marketing Manager posting. Master supports E001/E060/E063/E055/E078/E076/E114/E008/E009/E066. Do not assert owning alpha-to-GA SaaS launches, industrial CMMS expertise, product naming or adoption KPIs absent source evidence.
tools_rationale: Use actual supported analytics and CRM tools matching MaintainX's customer analysis requirements.
